paper_title: Leveraging ChatGPT As Text Annotation Tool For Sentiment Analysis
caption: Accuracy of ChatGPT VS VADER and TextBlob
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy of three text analysis models: TextBlob, VADER, and ChatGPT, across two categories of tweets. The horizontal axis represents the tweet categories, labeled "Emoji Tweets" and "Overall Tweet," with "Overall Tweet containing emojis" displayed as a subtitle. The vertical axis is labeled "Accuracy" and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick labels at 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8. Three bars are displayed, each representing a different model, and colored green. The "TextBlob" bar, represented by a white pattern, has an approximate height of 0.3. The "VADER" bar, depicted with a black and white diagonal pattern, has an approximate height of 0.56. The "ChatGPT" bar, colored solid green, reaches an approximate height of 0.6. The bars are sorted by their position along the horizontal axis, corresponding to the tweet categories, and there is no visual emphasis applied to any specific bar. A legend is provided to distinguish the colors representing each model, positioned in the lower right corner of the chart.
